core_obligations: The author extends the monotone rank method to approximation, turns a separating matrix into a Boolean function with controlled coordinate ranks, and uses pattern matrices plus certificate/approximate-degree separations to derive an explicit quasipolynomial-size lower bound. The full error-sensitive rank argument and function construction are retained. Resulting monotone phase-estimation space lower bounds and exact-span consequences are supporting context, not extra counts.
